candidates.change_summary: Change the required ETH amount from 10 ether to 9 ether, altering when fallback accepts and changes pastBlockTime.
Remove the timestamp ordering check so fallback can update pastBlockTime even when block.timestamp is not greater.
Set pastBlockTime to block.timestamp (instead of block.timestamp + 1), changing the stored value after calls.
Change the conditional so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0, altering when balance is emptied and thus observed state.
Replace transfer of the entire contract balance with sending a fixed 1 ether, changing resulting contract balance and thus observable behavior.
Insert an extra increment of pastBlockTime after assignment, changing the final stored value.
Delete the assignment to pastBlockTime so the state variable is unchanged by the fallback call.
Move the assignment to pastBlockTime to after the conditional transfer, changing observed pastBlockTime when transfer reverts or alters flow.
